entries.datasetTitle: Annual High-Resolution Forest Land Cover, Canada, 1984–2022

intendedRole.en: National annual forest-land-cover context for 1984–2022; not a claim of current coverage.
intendedRole.fr: Contexte national annuel de couverture des terres forestières pour 1984–2022; sans prétendre à une couverture actuelle.

verifiedFacts: Official catalogue identifies an annual 30-m forest-land-cover product for 1984–2022.

Catalogue describes national coverage of 650 million hectares of forested ecosystem and identifies NTEMS.

Catalogue assigns Open Government Licence – Canada and an as-needed update frequency.
